strategy.name: intraday_dynamic_independent_sma_period_cross_with_rebuy_and_stop
strategy.description: QQQ 初始空仓。买入与卖出分别使用可独立选择的长期 SMA 周期；每个交易日开盘前只用截至前一收盘的完成历史，解出当日价格等于相应 provisional SMA 的精确触发价。普通买入必须从前一日位于买入 SMA 下方或相等开始向上穿越，普通卖出必须从前一日位于卖出 SMA 上方或相等开始向下穿越。卖出后保留基于实际计成本卖出价的强制买回线，买入后可选基于实际计成本买入价的止损线。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓时，若前一完成 Close <= 前一完成 buy-SMA，则放置向上普通买单，动态价为 P=sum(previous buy_window-1 closes)/(buy_window-1)。若已有卖出，同时放置上次计成本卖出成交价×(1+forced_rebuy_pct/100) 的强制买回线；两条向上触发线取较低者优先。forced_rebuy_pct 必须为 3%、5%、8% 或 10%。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时，若前一完成 Close >= 前一完成 sell-SMA，则放置向下普通卖单，动态价为 P=sum(previous sell_window-1 closes)/(sell_window-1)。若 stop_loss_pct 开启，同时放置上次计成本买入成交价×(1-stop_loss_pct/100) 的止损线；两条向下触发线取较高者优先。关闭止损仅作为机制对照。
strategy.signal_time: 每个常规交易日开盘前，只使用截至前一交易日 Close 的完成历史、前一完成 SMA 状态和既有实际账户成交价，冻结当日资格与触发价；当日 Close 不参与当日订单。
strategy.execution_time: 若常规时段 Open 已越过预挂触发线则按 Open 成交；否则调整后日线 OHLC 触及时按精确理论线成交；随后施加单边 5 bps 不利成本。每日最多一笔，不允许买入后同日止损或卖出后同日买回。
strategy.positioning: long-only；2000-12-18 以 100,000 美元现金空仓开始；每次买入投入全部现金、每次卖出清空全部份额；允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.price_basis: approved split-and-dividend-adjusted QQQ OHLC; an internally consistent total-return approximation, not an exact raw-price corporate-action account replay

parameters.warmup_policy: Use QQQ history from 1999-03-10. The common analysis start is the first session with both a completed prior SMA450 and 449 completed closes available for the provisional SMA450 equation; all cases start flat on that same date.
parameters.legacy_symbol_mapping: forced_rebuy_pct is prior c; stop_loss_pct is prior d
parameters.subperiod_state_policy: Run one continuous strategy path. At each fixed subperiod boundary, inherit position and trigger anchors, rebase equity at the first bar, and compute subperiod CAGR/Sharpe without restarting or peeking.

identifiability_gate.purpose: Exclude one-entry hold artifacts from period selection and label enabled stop losses with too few primary events as descriptive insurance only.

surface_selection.grouping: Analyze each of the 20 forced-rebuy/stop-loss modes as a complete 38x38 buy-window by sell-window surface.
surface_selection.primary_metric: minimum CAGR across the three fixed inherited-state subperiods
surface_selection.boundary_policy: A component touching 80 or 450 is reported but cannot nominate a stable period region.
surface_selection.representative_rule: Within the largest eligible top-decile component, require a complete 3x3 neighborhood and maximize local median primary metric minus 0.5 times local standard deviation; break ties by full-history Sharpe, full-history CAGR, distance to component centroid, then lower turnover.

parameters.paired_correction_analysis: For every buy/sell period pair and forced-rebuy value, compare each enabled stop loss with the stop-loss-disabled control; report metric deltas and primary stop-loss event counts. Compare forced-rebuy values only on the same period pair and stop-loss mode.

multiple_testing.pbo_metric: Annualized daily Sharpe from the selected six-block training half and its six-block complement; the 12 chronological blocks are fixed before screening.
multiple_testing.trial_count_policy: Report correlation-adjusted effective trials and the conservative full 28,880-case count. DSR is applied only to predeclared surface representatives after their identities are frozen from the surface rule.

formal_reconciliation.surface_representatives: Reconcile the deterministic 3x3-local surface representative for every correction mode when defined. A representative from a boundary-touching or otherwise structurally failed component remains a diagnostic row and is not a stable nomination.
formal_reconciliation.objective_champions: deduplicated full-history CAGR, Sharpe and maximum-drawdown champions
formal_reconciliation.requirement: Every formal candidate must match PyBroker and the independent Python ledger in dates, sides, shares, fills, cash and equity within 1e-6. The two compiled full-grid ledgers must match every case metric and signal count.

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Invest the same 100,000 USD at the 2000-12-18 regular-session Open with 5 bps adverse entry cost and hold QQQ through 2015-12-31.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v4 unchanged. Build experiment-specific correction-mode comparisons, buy/sell-period heatmaps, plateau diagnostics, subperiod robustness, PBO/DSR and formal-candidate charts in the analyzer.

research.hypothesis: Replacing fixed SMA200 percentage buffers with independently selectable buy and sell SMA periods may reveal a broad, interpretable period plateau across the dot-com aftermath, pre/post-GFC years and 2011-2015 trend, while forced rebuy and stop-loss settings should be judged by paired event-aware comparisons rather than isolated winners.
research.primary_metric: Minimum inherited-state CAGR across the three frozen subperiods, subject to ordinary buy/sell identifiability and two-dimensional plateau structure.
research.selection_rule: Use parameters.surface_selection exactly. Full-history CAGR/Sharpe/max-drawdown champions are supplementary and cannot override the subperiod, event-count, boundary, PBO or DSR gates. Do not declare one future-optimal parameter from this scan.
research.validation_plan: Save all 28,880 case metrics, fixed-subperiod results, signal counts, paired stop-loss deltas, surface diagnostics, PBO splits and DSR inputs. Cross-check every case through two independently structured compiled ledgers; reconcile all predeclared formal candidates with PyBroker and a Python reference ledger; require hashes, full tests, catalog rebuild, workspace audit and real Chrome report interaction.
research.promotion_criteria: No direct promotion from this 2000-2015 exploratory scan. A period region may be nominated for a future locked 2016+ experiment only if it forms a non-boundary plateau meeting all structural and identifiability gates, has positive primary metric, PBO <=20%, effective-trials DSR >=95%, and does not depend on an underidentified stop-loss event count.
research.rejection_conditions: Do not nominate a unique buy/sell-period or correction mode if no qualifying two-dimensional plateau exists, the best component touches a search boundary, ordinary crossings are underidentified, stop-loss claims rely on fewer than 10 primary events, correction-mode conclusions conflict across subperiods, PBO exceeds 20%, DSR is below 95%, or any timing, accounting, count, hash, test, audit, catalog, strategy-card or browser gate fails.
